title: organizational knowledge
a chance to be found.
paragraphs: Emails, memos, internal documents and presentations hold the experience your organization has built. Yet they often sit across separate systems and teams, not yet organized into knowledge that AI can use effectively.
The next opportunity is to connect AI with the knowledge and resources inside your company. So employees can find an answer when they need one—and find the evidence behind it.

title: AI is changing
how companies allocate budgets.
outlook.intro: According to Investing.com’s account of a J.P. Morgan survey, the CIOs surveyed expected AI-accelerated computing hardware to take a larger share of IT budgets.
reading: In the 2024 survey, 33% of CIOs said they were cutting funding for other IT projects to support AI investment. Legacy systems, upgrades and infrastructure were most affected.
Yet 62% said they were not cutting other projects. The report suggested that most AI investment would be funded by additional budgets, rather than simply reallocating existing spending.
outlook.chartLabel: Respondents expected AI computing hardware to rise from 5 percent of IT budgets in 2024 to 14.5 percent three years later
outlook.spending: Together, the respondents oversaw $123 billion in annual enterprise IT spending.
outlook.caveat: These were respondents’ expectations in 2024—not realized results or evidence of Synaiq KIP’s performance.
outlook.detailsLabel: Read the survey context and source
outlook.details: The report described the three-year growth expectation as a compound annual growth rate of about 45%. Some 33% of CIOs said they would cut funding for other projects, with legacy systems/upgrades and infrastructure particularly affected; 62% said they would not cut other projects.
outlook.sourceCaveat: Based on media reporting; the full original J.P. Morgan survey was not available for review.
